recommendations.description: Add comprehensive security test suite covering XSS prevention, URI validation bypass attempts, MIME type parsing edge cases, malformed JSON payloads, tool call injection attempts, and rate limiting on event bridge calls. The renderer's use of createElement/textContent is excellent, but needs explicit test coverage to ensure no innerHTML or similar dangerous patterns exist.

Implement robust URI validation using URL parsing (not regex) with whitelisted schemes rather than blacklisting ui://. Add formal Zod-based payload validation layer before processing any untrusted input. Ensure MIME type normalization and strict parsing.

Implement strict allowlist-based validation for tool names called from the event bridge. Add rate limiting to prevent abuse of app-visibility tools. Document security implications of the visibility pattern.

Expand test coverage to include error paths, edge cases, and failure scenarios. Test helper functions with malformed inputs, empty arrays, null/undefined values, and boundary conditions. Add tests for concurrent interactions and race conditions in the event bridge.
Convert isViewContentBlock() to a proper TypeScript type guard for better type narrowing. Extract validation logic into reusable functions. Add readonly modifiers to prevent accidental mutations.
Add regression tests for the basic-host sendFile fix, verifying files can be served from dot-directories like .claude/worktrees. Test with various path configurations including symlinks.
Add pre-commit or pre-build hooks to automatically regenerate Zod schemas from TypeScript types. Add CI check that fails if generated files are out of sync with source types.

Add comprehensive JSDoc documentation to all public APIs covering purpose, parameters, return values, thrown errors, usage examples, and security considerations. Document the wildcard ["*"] capability and its security implications.

Extract DOM creation helpers for the renderer to centralize safe element creation. Modernize MIME type checking using Set for better performance. Improve function naming to better convey intent (e.g., bridgeUiEventToToolCall).
Run npm audit to check for vulnerabilities in new dependencies. Set up automated dependency scanning in CI pipeline to catch security issues early.
